integrity: The proof and exact arithmetic checker are included; no external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The comparison is restricted to independent geometric resets on a homogeneous nearest-neighbor finite interval, with starting law equal to reset law.
Transform ordering does not establish stochastic domination.
The finite checker does not prove infinitely many parameter cases.
Complete texts of closely related 2026 companion papers could not be accessed; historical priority remains uncertain.
title: Sharp transform ordering and exponential mean gap among reset-neutral gambler’s-ruin laws
